title: Tapas tour!  Yes bring it again!
text: Kristina was absolutely, hands down the best foodie guide we have experienced as a family. Her explanations of core Tapas cuisine was both informative and tasty!  BOOK her at your next earliest opportunity and make it a pint to have her lead your couple or family in your cuisine explorations.  You will not be disappointed!  Such a fun and entertaining experience in Spains best cuisine.
author: JerryLauraB

title: A Tour w/ Someone Who Loves His Job
text: Jason was an amazing tour guide! And we were lucky to have a great group on top of it. This tour gave us the most delicious food and was way more than we ever expected. You can tell when your guide is truly invested in the city that he is providing a tour in and really enjoys his job. 1M% recommend this tour

title: So Much Food
text: Great time with Cate our guide. Super friendly in telling her experiences and filling us in on each restaurant and there specialties. We talked history and customs on things we passed and different neighborhoods. The food was amazing, elevated from tourist tapas. And wonderful different drinks at each although she always offered several choices. Cate also offered suggestions when we parted of her fav places. Highly recommend!
